description: This file is part of the PDU Router (PduR) module within an AUTOSAR-based automotive software platform. It contains implementation of LIN Interface related functions, including handling of receive indications, transmission confirmations, and trigger transmit actions.

methods.name: void PduR_LinIfRxIndication(PduIdType LinRxPduId,const PduInfoType * PduInfoPtr)
methods.description: Handles reception indication for LIN interface PDUs, calling the associated ARC_RX indication with specific parameters.

methods.name: void PduR_LinIfTxConfirmation(PduIdType LinTxPduId)
methods.description: Handles transmission confirmation for LIN interface PDUs, calling the ARC_TxConfirmation function.

methods.name: Std_ReturnType PduR_LinIfTriggerTransmit(PduIdType LinTxPduId,PduInfoType * PduInfoPtr)
methods.description: Requests transmission of a PDU through the trigger transmit mechanism, calling the ARC_TriggerTransmit function.
